existingTranslations.ja: "不儲存退出" = "保存せずに終了";

behavior: Only the alert for a failed current visible close offers Exit Without Saving; ordinary OK retains the form and dirty workingMap.
The explicit discard carries the failed exit generation and requires that exact operation to have returned/drained; it rejects system disappearance and stale/active exit tasks.

The same owned close path cancels and drains operations, skips the credential mutation for explicit abandonment, then allows the existing dismissal. It does not acknowledge a save, clear dirty state, erase old Keychain data or automatically write on the following disappearance.
